sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, update your profile, or communicate with other users. This includes your name, username, email address, password, and profile information.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, send you technical notices and support messages, respond to your comments and questions, and to send you marketing communications where permitted by law.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with vendors, consultants, and other service providers who need access to such information to carry out work on our behalf.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide the services and fulfill the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: Under GDPR, CCPA, and CPRA, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can also object to processing or request data portability at any time.

sections.heading: Account & Data Deletion
sections.body: You can delete your account and all associated data directly from Settings. Once initiated, all personal information, posts, and matches will be permanently removed from our active servers within 30 days.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@coolvibes.lgbt.

sections.heading: What Are Cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us remember your preferences and improve your experience.

sections.heading: Essential Cookies
sections.body: These cookies are required for the website to function and cannot be disabled. They include authentication tokens and session identifiers.

sections.heading: Analytics Cookies
sections.body: We use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our site. This information is used to improve our services.

sections.heading: Managing Cookies
sections.body: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect site functionality.

sections.heading: Age & Eligibility
sections.body: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use CoolVibes. By using the service, you represent that you meet this age requirement.

sections.heading: User Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for safeguarding your credentials. We reserve the right to verify identities and remove accounts that provide false information.

sections.heading: Apple EULA Acknowledgement
sections.body: By using CoolVibes on an iOS device, you acknowledge that these terms are between you and CoolVibes only, not Apple. Your use of the app must also comply with Apple’s Standard EULA.

sections.heading: UGC Moderation SLA
sections.body: We maintain a zero-tolerance policy for objectionable content. All reports regarding User Generated Content (UGC) are reviewed within 24 hours. We reserve the right to remove non-compliant content and ban users immediately.

sections.heading: Prohibited Content
sections.body: You may not post content that is illegal, harmful, or violates others’ rights. This includes a strict ban on "Sugar Dating", sexual solicitation, and any form of harassment.

sections.heading: Zero Tolerance for CSAM
sections.body: We have zero tolerance for Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM). Any such content will be removed immediately, and the involved accounts will be reported to the appropriate authorities.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: We may terminate or suspend your account at our sole discretion, without prior notice, for any conduct that we believe violates these Terms or is harmful to our community.

sections.heading: Changes to Terms
sections.body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.description: Building a safe and inclusive space

sections.heading: Be Respectful
sections.body: CoolVibes is a safe space for the LGBTQ+ community and allies. Treat all members with kindness and respect, regardless of their identity or background.

sections.heading: Zero Tolerance for Hate
sections.body: Hate speech, discrimination, harassment, or bullying based on sexual orientation, gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, or any other characteristic is strictly prohibited.

sections.heading: Authentic Profiles
sections.body: Use your real identity or a consistent pseudonym. Impersonating other people or creating fake profiles is not allowed.

sections.heading: Safe Content
sections.body: Keep content appropriate. Explicit sexual content must be marked as such. Child sexual abuse material (CSAM) is strictly prohibited and will be reported to authorities.

sections.heading: Safe Content
sections.body: Keep content appropriate. Explicit sexual content must be marked as such. We maintain a zero-tolerance policy for harassment and abusive behavior.

sections.heading: Reporting & Blocking
sections.body: If you encounter any violation or feel unsafe, use the "Report" or "Block" features immediately. All reports are reviewed by our safety team within 24 hours to ensure a safe environment for all.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Our commitment to an inclusive experience

sections.heading: Our Commitment
sections.body: CoolVibes is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually improve the user experience for everyone.

sections.heading: Standards
sections.body: We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible.

sections.heading: Features
sections.body: Our platform supports screen readers, keyboard navigation, sufficient color contrast, and resizable text to ensure usability for all users.

sections.heading: Feedback
sections.body: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of CoolVibes. Please contact us at accessibility@coolvibes.lgbt if you experience accessibility barriers.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.body: CoolVibes is a social platform built for the LGBTQ+ community. Our mission is to create a safe, vibrant, and inclusive space where everyone can express themselves authentically.

sections.heading: Our Values
sections.body: We believe in authenticity, inclusivity, respect, and community. Every feature we build is designed with the safety and empowerment of LGBTQ+ individuals in mind.

sections.heading: The Team
sections.body: CoolVibes is built and maintained by a diverse, passionate team of people who believe in the power of community and connection.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Reach us at hello@coolvibes.lgbt for partnerships, press inquiries, or general questions.

sections.heading: Getting Started
sections.body: Create an account, complete your profile, and start connecting with the LGBTQ+ community near you. Use the Nearby feature to discover people in your area.

sections.heading: Account Issues
sections.body: If you have trouble logging in, use the "Forgot Password" option on the login screen. If you continue to have issues, contact support@coolvibes.lgbt.

sections.heading: Privacy & Safety
sections.body: You can block or report any user from their profile page. Reports are reviewed by our moderation team within 24 hours.

sections.heading: Deleting Your Account
sections.body: You can delete your account from Settings → Account → Delete Account. This action is permanent and all your data will be removed within 30 days.

sections.heading: Contact Support
sections.body: For any other issues, email us at support@coolvibes.lgbt or use the in-app feedback button in Settings.

conduct.title: Code of Conduct
conduct.description: Prioritizing safety and well-being for all members

sections.heading: Core Principle
sections.body: CoolVibes prioritizes the safety and well-being of marginalized people over the comfort of privileged members. We are dedicated to providing a harassment-free experience for everyone.

sections.heading: Prohibited Conduct
sections.body: We do not tolerate harassment, bullying, or discrimination. This includes: no questioning of stated identities, no incitement of violence, no deliberate "outing", and no publication of private communications without consent.

sections.heading: Zero Tolerance for Hate
sections.body: No racist, sexist, cissexist, ableist, or otherwise oppressive behavior is allowed, whether casual or explicit. This includes harmful language or actions toward people of color, trans folks, and disabled members.

sections.heading: Reporting Violations
sections.body: If you see a violation, please use the report button on the profile or post. Our moderation team reviews all reports within 24 hours and will prioritize the well-being of those affected.

sections.heading: Consequences
sections.body: Participants asked to stop harmful behavior must comply immediately. Administrators may take any action deemed appropriate, up to and including permanent expulsion from CoolVibes.

sections.heading: Community Accountability
sections.body: We foster a culture of accountability and growth. We encourage discussions challenging privilege and respect the emotional labor provided by marginalized members of our community.
